import sys,json,time,uuid,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"deploy")
import voice_stack as v
stamp=uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
names=["VoiceProbeA"+stamp,"VoiceProbeB"+stamp]
contexts=["probe_a_"+stamp,"probe_b_"+stamp]
report={"names":names,"contexts":contexts,"turns":[],"checks":{}}
def get(context):
 return json.loads(v.request("/codex/sessions?context_id="+context))
def ask(text,expected,context):
 result=json.loads(v.request("/chat/completions",json.dumps({"context_id":context,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":text}]}).encode()))
 report["turns"].append({"request":text,"context_id":context,**result})
 print(json.dumps(report["turns"][-1]),flush=True)
 assert any(t["name"]==expected and t["ok"] for t in result["tools"]),result
 assert not result.get("controls",{}).get("pause_listening"),result
 return result
try:
 health=json.loads(v.request("/chat/health"))
 expected={"create_session","list_sessions","select_session","send","status","steer","interrupt","answer","updates","archive_session"}
 assert {n.removeprefix("mcp__codex__") for n in health["tools"] if n.startswith("mcp__codex__")}==expected,health["tools"]
 for name,context in zip(names,contexts):
  ask("Create a Codex session named "+name+". Use its default isolated workspace. Do not start a task yet.","mcp__codex__create_session",context)
 views=[get(c) for c in contexts]
 assert all(x["enabled"] for x in views)
 rows={r["name"]:r for r in views[0]["sessions"] if r["name"] in names}
 assert len(rows)==2,rows
 assert views[0]["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[0]]["session_id"]
 assert views[1]["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[1]]["session_id"]
 selected=json.loads(v.request("/codex/sessions/select",json.dumps({"context_id":contexts[0],"session":rows[names[1]]["session_id"]}).encode()))
 assert selected["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[1]]["session_id"]
 assert get(contexts[1])["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[1]]["session_id"]
 # Switch only first conversation back by the voice tool.
 ask("Switch the selected Codex session to "+names[0]+".","mcp__codex__select_session",contexts[0])
 assert get(contexts[0])["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[0]]["session_id"]
 assert get(contexts[1])["selected_session_id"]==rows[names[1]]["session_id"]
 report["checks"]["separate_selections"]=True
 ask("Tell the selected Codex session to implement probe.py containing square(x) that returns x*x, and run Python assertions for square(-3)==9 and square(0)==0. Use only its own project directory.","mcp__codex__send",contexts[0])
 deadline=time.monotonic()+150
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  current=next(r for r in get(contexts[0])["sessions"] if r["name"]==names[0])
  assert current["state"] not in ["failed","unknown"],current
  if current["state"]=="idle" and current["thread_id"]:break
  time.sleep(1)
 else:raise AssertionError(current)
 report["checks"]["real_coding_completion"]=current
 ask("What is the status of the selected Codex session?","mcp__codex__status",contexts[0])
 ask("Read "+rows[names[0]]["cwd"]+"/probe.py using the direct workspace file tools.","mcp__workspace__read_file",contexts[0])
 report["checks"]["direct_read_path"]=rows[names[0]]["cwd"]+"/probe.py"
 for name,context in zip(names,contexts):
  ask("Archive the finished Codex session named "+name+". Keep all project files.","mcp__codex__archive_session",context)
 assert not any(r["name"] in names for r in get(contexts[0])["sessions"])
 report["checks"]["archived_without_deleting_projects"]=True
 report["passed"]=True
finally:
 pathlib.Path("evidence/deployed-check.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
 print(json.dumps({"passed":report.get("passed",False),"checks":report["checks"]},indent=2),flush=True)
